Early development release of NicoClient, an independent launcher and Fabric mod for Minecraft Java 1.21.11.

**Install:** download `NicoClient-Setup-*.exe` below and run it. The installer is unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen shows a warning: choose More info, then Run anyway.

**You need:** Windows 64-bit, the official Minecraft Launcher and your own Minecraft Java account.

**Play:** press PLAY, choose the NicoClient Fabric 1.21.11 profile in the official launcher and start it. In the game, Right Shift opens the menu.

**Updates:** NicoClient downloads new versions on its own and installs them on restart.

Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
